test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is Telangana’s first Sangeet Natak Akademi Award winner?
solution:
The correct answer is __Padmaja Reddy__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Padmaja Reddy:**

__
 
• Kuchipudi dancer, Padmaja Reddy received the Padma Shri Award in 2022.
 
• Padmaja Reddy is from Hyderabad
 
• She has received Sangeeta Nataka Akademi Award, the highest award given by the Indian government to practicing artists.
 
• she was the first person from Telangana to ever receive this honor.
 
• She also runs a dance academy called Pranav Institute of Kuchipudi Dance.
 
• She was invited to give a performance at the official residence of India’s Prime Minister:
